data.narrative:
Slate Auto is a Series C transportation company founded by Miles Arnone, Will Barker, and Jeff Wilke (former CEO of Worldwide Consumer at Amazon). The company has raised $1.4B to date. The valuation comp universe in Transportation includes 8 private peers—notably Rivian, The Boring Company, Einride, ZeroAvia, and Harbinger—with no public comparables identified.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, as a peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow Transportation peer set (fewer than 3 datapoints met filtering criteria). The stage-progression method applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $1.4B total capital raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $2.4B.

The triangulated range is $2.0B to $2.7B, with a central estimate of $2.4B. This range reflects conservative and optimistic applications of the single applicable methodology. Key uncertainties include the materiality of the $1.4B raised as a valuation proxy (affected by burn rate, deployment timing, and dilution across rounds) and the absence of direct peer stage-matching data, which limits cross-validation of the step-up multiplier. Further clarity on revenue traction, capital efficiency, and path to subsequent funding rounds would strengthen conviction in this range.
